description: This file defines the CRServiceWorker class, which extends Worker, managing service worker behavior in Chromium within the Playwright project. It handles network management, session events, and communication with the browser context.

classes.name: CRServiceWorker
classes.description: A class extending Worker that manages service worker lifecycle, network interactions, and event handling in Chromium.

methods.name: didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service worker is closed.

methods.name: updateOffline
methods.description: Updates the offline status of the network manager.

methods.name: updateHttpCredentials
methods.description: Updates HTTP credentials for network requests.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Updates extra HTTP headers for network requests.

methods.name: updateRequestInterception
methods.description: Configures request interception based on current settings.

methods.name: needsRequestInterception
methods.description: Determines if request interception is needed.

methods.name: reportRequestFinished
methods.description: Emits an event when a request has finished.

methods.name: requestFailed
methods.description: Emits an event when a request fails.

methods.name: requestReceivedResponse
methods.description: Emits an event when a response is received.

methods.name: requestStarted
methods.description: Emits an event when a request starts.

methods.name: _isNetworkInspectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if network inspection is enabled.
